description: Composite four-panel figure mixing three optical micrographs (a–c) and one FESEM micrograph (d), every panel carrying a 20 µm scale bar. (a), labelled green "as-cast", is an optical image of the as-cast Fe–10Al–15Mn–0.8C–5Ni wt% low-density steel: dark blocky/elongated dendrites marked δ with yellow arrows, embedded in a lighter γ austenite matrix (yellow arrow). (b), labelled "HR", shows that after hot rolling the dendrites have become near-horizontal light lamellar bands, labelled "B2 stringer band" (white arrow), separated by γ matrix marked with blue double-headed arrows; ND/RD reference axes sit at lower left. (c), labelled "CR", shows the same lamellar architecture after cold rolling, with thinner, more closely spaced B2 stringer bands and pancaked γ, again with blue γ arrows and ND/RD axes. (d), labelled "HR", is a wide secondary-electron FESEM image of the hot-rolled state: a dark-aged γ matrix cut by bright linear features labelled "shear band in γ" (long orange arrow) and small bright particles labelled "IG-B2" (intragranular B2 precipitation), additional orange arrows marking further shear bands and IG-B2. No numeric values besides the scale bars are printed.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is an optical micrograph labelled 'as-cast' showing dark elongated/blocky dendrites in a lighter matrix, with yellow arrows explicitly labelling the dark phase δ and the light matrix phase γ.

Panel (b) is an optical micrograph labelled 'HR' in which the dendritic constituent has been converted into light, elongated near-horizontal lamellae whose label reads exactly 'B2 stringer band' (white arrow), with blue double-headed arrows marking the γ matrix.

Panel (c) is an optical micrograph labelled 'CR' showing the same 'B2 stringer band' + γ architecture as (b) but with visibly thinner and more closely spaced bands, indicating further thinning during cold rolling.
Panels (b) and (c) both include a small ND/RD reference-axis glyph at their lower-left corner, indicating the normal direction and rolling direction.
Panel (d) is a secondary-electron FESEM micrograph labelled 'HR' in which bright linear features are labelled 'shear band in γ' and small bright precipitates are labelled 'IG-B2'.
All four panels contain a scale bar annotated '20 µm'.
The caption states that (a) shows δ-ferrite in the austenite (γ) matrix of the as-cast sample and that δ-ferrite transforms into lamellar B2 stringer bands after HR and CR.
The caption states that (d) is a FESEM image showing intragranular-B2 (IG-B2) precipitation at shear bands of HR-γ.
The citing text states that 27% δ-ferrite remains in the as-cast microstructure at room temperature in equilibrium with γ; this value is not printed in the figure itself.
The citing text states that a rough estimation reduces the dendrite fraction from 27% in the as-cast microstructure to 19% after HR — a quoted result, not a number printed on any panel.
The citing text states that hot rolling was carried out between 1050 and 900 °C, repeated in nine stages, and that the CR step packs the γ and further thins the B2 stringer bands.
The citing text states that solute partition from γ into δ during homogenization at 1150 °C for 2 h transforms δ to B2 via an order–disorder transition prevailing at 1125 °C in this alloy system.
The citing text attributes the localisation of strain in γ (shear bands, seen in panel d) to the requirement that the γ matrix deform in synchrony with the channeling of dendrite mass along RD.

subfigures.description: Optical micrograph of the as-cast sample (green label 'as-cast'), 20 µm scale bar. Dark, blocky and elongated dendritic constituent labelled δ with yellow arrows, set in the lighter γ austenite matrix (yellow arrow).

Optical micrograph of the hot-rolled condition (green label 'HR'), 20 µm scale bar. Light, elongated near-horizontal lamellae labelled 'B2 stringer band' (white arrow) alternating with γ matrix marked by blue double-headed arrows; ND/RD axes at lower left.

Optical micrograph of the cold-rolled condition (green label 'CR'), 20 µm scale bar. Same banded architecture but with thinner, denser B2 stringer bands and flattened γ, labelled 'B2 stringer band' with blue γ arrows and ND/RD axes.

Wide FESEM (secondary-electron) micrograph of the HR condition (green label 'HR'), 20 µm scale bar. Dark etched γ matrix traversed by bright linear features labelled 'shear band in γ' and dotted with small bright particles labelled 'IG-B2'; several orange arrows mark individual shear bands and particles.

unreadable_items: No magnification values are printed on any panel — only 20 µm scale bars
Panel (d): the individual IG-B2 particles are only a few pixels across at the supplied resolution, so their size/shape cannot be measured
The optical panels (a–c) give no etch/contrast legend, so the exact fraction of each phase cannot be read from the pixels
